dedupe_keys.name: ibge trecho de drenagem cartas topograficas 50 000 100 000

description: IBGE - TRECHO DE DRENAGEM - CARTAS TOPOGRÁFICAS 50.000 - 100.000 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Os trechos de drenagem foram digitalizados a partir das cartas topográficas do IBGE, unidos e reprojetados para o DATUM SIRGAS2000 UTM z 24 S, formando uma base contínua que recobre todo o ES. Na metade sul do Estado a escala das cartas é de 1:50.000 e na metade norte, 1:100.000. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are es, features, trecho_drenagem, trecho_drenagem_ibge, Espirito Santo. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
